arguments.title: [TEST] Star Gazer — Calendar integration
arguments.description:
Star Gazer integration test: star-gazer-calendar-20261115-01

SOFTWARE TEST ONLY. No observing trip, travel or attendance is scheduled.

This event checks Google Calendar creation, timezone, attendee handling, description, route links and guest notifications for the Star Gazer prototype.

Live Geoapify MCP checks passed: geocoding, categories, places, route matrices and detailed routes. A public central-Prague walking example returned 7 minutes in both matrix and route calculations.
Example navigation link (public test coordinate, no private origin): https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=50.078%2C14.44&travelmode=walking

The live planner also ran with real weather and journeys. It correctly blocked an invitation for a site whose night access was unverified. This separate Calendar integration test does not approve that site.

Location tools: https://www.geoapify.com/
Weather: https://open-meteo.com/ (CC BY 4.0)
Astronomy Engine: https://github.com/cosinekitty/astronomy

Only the calendar owner is listed. The event is private and marked free, with reminders disabled. Event creation does not prove email delivery.
arguments.location: Software integration test — no physical meeting
